content: Transformer-XL and BERT both have low perplexity and pseudo-perplexity scores, but both cannot be directly compared as they are calculated quite differently (Eq.DISPLAY_FORM4, Eq.DISPLAY_FORM6). The dramatically low scores of BERT indicate that per word predicted probability is higher than that of a uni-directional model. Thus the predicted word probability distribution is much sharper when compared to the XL model probability distribution. At this point, we cannot say which model architecture has performed better- BERT or Transformer-XL, despite both of them achieving good low perplexity scores. We would need to experiment with a downstreaming task in-order to fairly compare model performances.
